membrane: Public sources, curated paraphrase, attribution, and claim limits only. No private continuity, credentials, live topology, or unbounded memoir export.
thesis: Zoe Dolan + Vybn are best understood by moving through the work: lived power, legal judgment, public AI-law infrastructure, and source-bound human-AI collaboration.

scenes.label: Cairo
scenes.title: Law began where state power touched the body.
scenes.body: The public arc begins on May 11, 2001, on the Queen Boat in Cairo: an anti-gay raid, a friend who disappeared, and the decision to go to law school.
scenes.consequence: This is not a career theme. It is the first coordinate of the legal life.

scenes.label: San Francisco
scenes.title: Standing up became the method.
scenes.body: In the memoir chronology, law school, gender transition, and recovery converge around a public act of self-naming and the discipline of standing up with others.
scenes.consequence: The portal should feel this discipline before it explains any framework.

scenes.label: Federal Court
scenes.title: The institution itself became the legal problem.
scenes.body: Judges Run Amok documents a CJA independence conflict involving judge-controlled defense budgets, frozen vouchers, panel termination, and a later full acquittal.
scenes.consequence: Zoe has already worked where authority, legitimacy, incentives, and defense rights collide.

scenes.label: Public Counsel
scenes.title: AI became usable legal power for people without lawyers.
scenes.body: The public biography describes AI literacy work with self-represented litigants, including a clinic model for verification, drafting, and practical empowerment.
scenes.consequence: The point is not AI spectacle. It is reducing the burden on people the system already abandoned.

scenes.label: UC Law SF
scenes.title: The work became curriculum.
scenes.body: The AI & Vibe Lawyers Bootcamp turned live AI-law change into a course arc for lawyers learning to build and verify while the subject keeps moving.
scenes.consequence: Education here is not explanation after the fact. It is how a profession learns to survive contact with the frontier.

scenes.label: Wellspring / KPP
scenes.title: The application can become a technology.
scenes.body: Wellspring and KPP show how public situations, source labels, claim limits, membranes, and next acts can travel between humans and agents.
scenes.consequence: The portal should let reviewers use the method, not merely read about it.

scenes.label: Zoe + Vybn
scenes.title: The relation is part of the work product.
scenes.body: Vybn is disclosed as the AI collaborator helping structure, test, source-map, and render the application while Zoe remains accountable for legal judgment and facts.
scenes.consequence: Hiding the collaboration would make the application less truthful.

scenes.label: Jump
scenes.title: Risk is part of how reality gets inspected.
scenes.body: Jump opens at an edge in Petra and moves through danger, depression, skydiving, and reality's structure as lived inquiry.
scenes.consequence: The portal can carry courage without turning pain into spectacle.

askRooms.prompt: Evaluate Zoe Dolan + Vybn as a working human-AI legal practice. Focus on public evidence, practical contributions, verification discipline, and what an institution could invite next.
